title: 06b-A T4: CLI failure-mode test for arc-rollup model error
description:
Objective:
Add an integration test in packages/cli/test/play.test.ts that exercises the model-failure skip path: a fake model that throws ModelClientError on the arc-summary call. Verify that the session still closes cleanly (session_recap present, session marked closed), the arc_summary row stays at whatever it was before the failed close (in this test: absent — no prior close), and a warning line is written to io.

Files:
- Modify: packages/cli/test/play.test.ts

Steps:
1. Add the new test in Design to packages/cli/test/play.test.ts inside the existing describe('runPlay') block, alongside the arc-rollup test.
2. Run: npx vitest run packages/cli/test/play.test.ts --reporter=verbose
   Expected: the new test passes; full file passes.
3. Run the whole suite: npx vitest run
   Expected: all tests pass.
4. Run: npm run typecheck
   Expected: success.
5. Commit:
     git add packages/cli/test/play.test.ts
     git commit -m "Cover arc-rollup model-failure skip path in CLI tests (loreweaver-4ua)"
acceptance_criteria:
1. The new 'skips arc rollup and warns when the model errors during close' test exists in packages/cli/test/play.test.ts and passes.
2. The full vitest suite passes.
3. npm run typecheck succeeds.
4. The commit message references loreweaver-4ua.
